settings.autostartText: FC-Tracker starts quietly in the tray when you log in – tracking and syncs are ready before you open FC 27.
settings.syncAfterPlayText: When you close FC 27 after Ultimate Team your club has changed. Remind me: a notice and a hint here – you click Sync only. Automatically: the browser opens, syncs and closes by itself.
settings.missingSideText: Which edge of the screen the list sits on. It moves at once, also while FC 27 runs.
settings.dataText: Club, Gallery and settings – stored only on this PC.

toast.syncRunningLine: Menus are fine. You get a notice here when it is done.

ln.pair.get: No extension yet? Get it at fc-tracker.com/download
update.text: Installs in a few seconds and restarts the app.
tile.extension.outdatedText: From the Chrome Web Store it updates by itself, usually within a day. From the .zip: download it, replace the folder, then press Reload in chrome://extensions.
error.update_failed: The update could not be installed ({{detail}}). Try again later or download it on fc-tracker.com.
tile.extension.waitingText: The extension checks in as soon as Chrome or Edge runs.
tile.extension.silentText: Chrome or Edge is open, but the extension doesn't answer – it may have been removed or turned off.
demo.padHint: Got a PlayStation or Xbox controller? Connect it and press any button – then drive the demo with the D-pad.
demo.padLegend: D-pad: move · L1/R1 = LB/RB: category · ✕/A: open · ○/B: back · ▢/X: card info · right stick: scroll
help.noController: No controller connected – pick yours to see its buttons.
help.c.overlay.title: Overlay on / off
help.c.overlay.desc: Opens FC-Tracker on top of the game: your Gallery with points, grades and what to do next. Hold again to close it.
help.c.missing.title: Buy next on / off
help.c.missing.desc: A slim list at the edge of the screen with the cards that add the most points to the set you are in. It never takes focus from the game.
help.c.category.title: Change category
help.c.category.desc: Steps through Leagues, Clubs, Rarities and the other Gallery categories.
help.c.move.title: Move
help.c.move.desc: Moves between the sets in the list – and between the cards once a set is open.
help.c.open.title: Open a set
help.c.open.desc: Opens the highlighted set, so you can move through its cards.
help.c.info.title: Card info
help.c.info.desc: Shows the card's version and first-owner status right next to the card.
help.c.back.title: Back / close
help.c.back.desc: Steps back one level. From the list it closes the overlay.
help.c.scroll.title: Scroll
help.c.scroll.desc: Scrolls through a long set. A small push scrolls slowly, a full push fast.
help.matchNote: In a match FC-Tracker steps aside – these buttons only do what the game does there.
overlay.recordingHint: A screen recording is running: while you just look, the game keeps the focus so the recording keeps the game. Your first controller press here also reaches the game, then the controller drives the overlay.
support.hint: FC-Tracker is free and made by one person – support it on Ko-fi
support.title: Support FC-Tracker
support.text: Free, no ads, made by one person. Your support first goes to a code-signing certificate.
support.qr: QR code to the Ko-fi page
support.scan: Scan with your phone – Apple Pay or Google Pay in seconds.
missing.sideHint: Move the list to the other side of the screen
ingame.step.unmatched: A better selection exists, but a card on the set page isn't in your synced club yet – sync, then open the set again
overlay.regradeSelection: The best selection – put these {{count}} cards in (set → Swap Player), then Confirm Changes:
speed.lead: How fast FC-Tracker notices what happens in the menus. Faster costs more CPU. Nothing runs during a match.
speed.autoHint: Auto uses {{preset}} on this PC (one step lighter on battery). Changing a value below switches to Custom.
speed.continuousText: Watches the game window all the time in the menus, scaled down on the graphics card. Off: the screen is copied on every look.
speed.watchText: How often the screen is checked for a change. The game shows a new picture every 7–17 ms, so below 16 ms gives nothing.
speed.sameText: One delay for still screens, moving screens and the transfer market.
speed.allText: Read once unchanged this long – and every time it passes while a screen keeps moving.
speed.stillText: Menus and set pages: read once unchanged this long. 0 = right away.
speed.animatedText: Packs, New Items, 3D backgrounds: read after this long, and again every time it passes while it moves.
speed.marketText: Search results, Bidding Options and purchases: read after this long.
speed.cost: ≈ {{looks}} looks per second. A read takes ≈ 0.3 s, so reads never come closer than that.
speed.match: In a match only a small check every 5 s runs.

diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.text: For 30 minutes, save every picture the tracking reads and what it made of it – to send when something was missed. Stays on this PC.
diag.running: Saving every read · {{minutes}} min left. Play as usual, then zip the folder and email it to hello@fc-tracker.com with a line on what went wrong.

progress.newItemsLine: Checking what the cards add to your Gallery
progress.biddingLine: What the card would add to your Gallery

sync.noExtension: Action needed: no answer from the FC-Tracker extension. The Web App opened in your default browser – it has to be Chrome or Edge with FC-Tracker added and connected. Open the Web App there, or stop the sync.
toast.autoLine: It can replace first owners – the side panel (double-tap View / Create) shows the best selection for {{set}}

settings.sourceText: Every line of FC-Tracker is public, so you can check what it does.

web.source.cardHint: PlayStation or Xbox through a capture card (Elgato & co.)
web.borderless: PC: play in borderless or windowed mode – true fullscreen often shares a black picture.
web.status.off: Share your game to start reading.
web.status.watching: Watching · open a Gallery set in FC 27
web.status.unclear: That page wasn't clear – hold it still for a moment

web.ctaHint: FC-Tracker for Windows – live on top of the game
web.intro.title: Your Gallery, read from your screen
web.intro.step1: Share FC 27 – your screen, an Xbox Cloud tab or a capture card.
web.intro.step2: Open a Gallery set. FC-Tracker reads it and works out your best selection and the cards to buy next.
web.intro.step3: Add the Chrome extension to sync your whole club – or open Swap Player to show your cards for a set.
web.intro.private: Your game and club never leave your browser – no account, no upload. Only anonymous usage counts are sent.
web.console: On PlayStation or Xbox? Use a capture card or Xbox Cloud. On PC the app does all of this live on top of the game.
web.nudge.title: Read in {{ms}} ms – in a browser tab
web.nudge.text: The Windows app does this live on top of the game without sharing anything, reads faster, sees First Owner and keeps your whole club up to date.
web.resetConfirm: Forget everything this browser has read?
web.unofficial: Unofficial fan project – not affiliated with EA.
web.sync.get: Sync your club – add or update the extension
web.sync.getHint: The FC-Tracker extension reads your club in EA's Web App – the same sync as the app, a page about every second
web.sync.running: Syncing your club in the Web App…
settings.usageText: Counts that FC-Tracker runs (for the online count) and how far setup got, and shares EA's market averages you see with other users on your market – never your club, players or EA account. A random number keeps one PC from counting twice.
online.hint: FC-Tracker apps and browser tabs in use right now
missing.priceTitle: EA market average on your market · {{age}}
missing.priceNote: ≈ coins = EA's own market average – yours, or another FC-Tracker user's on the same market.
value.title: What each grade costs
value.reachedNote: Grade {{grade}} is already yours with the cards you have.
value.noBuys: No buys needed – just place the right cards and regrade.
value.howTo: Buy the dearest first, put it in the set, sell it again, then the next – a card counts after it is sold. You lose only EA's 5 % tax.
value.overNote: More than your {{coins}} coins – nothing above your balance is suggested.
value.unpricedNote: {{count}} cards that could do it have no price yet. Prices come from EA's market average as FC-Tracker users see it – it fills up by itself.
value.impossibleNote: Not reachable without first owner cards (bought cards are never first owner).
value.rowNothing: Nothing to gain within your coins
value.calculating: Calculating the best value of every set…
value.empty: No sets yet – sync your club or open a Gallery set in-game.
value.plannerSub: The most tokens for the least tax, from the cards you have – never more than your coins.
value.planEmpty: Nothing to buy within these coins.
value.planEmptyPrices: Not enough prices yet. Prices come from EA's market average as FC-Tracker users see it – check back after a sync.
missing.overBudget: {{count}} cards above your {{coins}} coins left out
missing.nextGrade: Best value next: grade {{grade}} · +{{tokens}} tokens · {{tax}} tax · {{buys}} buys
value.how1: Start with the dearest card on the list. The most you ever need at once is "Coins needed".
value.how2: Open the set in the Gallery, Swap Player → put the card in, Confirm Changes, then Regrade. The tokens are yours.
value.how3: List it on the market. A card keeps counting in the Gallery after it's sold – you only lose EA's 5 % tax.
value.neededHint: the most you need at once
value.setsHint: sets that go up a grade
value.stepCards: Buy these {{count}}, put them in {{set}} and Regrade to {{grade}} – then sell them again.
value.stepNoBuy: No buys: put the right cards you have in {{set}} and Regrade to {{grade}}.
value.pricesBody: {{sets}} sets can't be planned yet – {{cards}} of their cards have no price.
value.pricesWhy: Why: EA only sends a card's price when someone has it in their club or searches it on the market. FC-Tracker users share these prices automatically (only the card, its price and when), so this list fills up by itself with every sync.
value.pricesHelp: Want a set sooner? Search one of its players on the Web App's transfer market – its price joins the list for everyone.
value.tooDear: {{count}} grades cost more than your coins and are left out.
value.tickTitle: Tick it off when it's bought, placed and sold again
value.gradeNeeds: Grade {{grade}} needs a score of {{score}} and gives {{tokens}} tokens.
value.slotsLeft: {{count}} empty slots – a set gets a grade once every slot is filled
value.excludeTitle: Leave this card out – the next best one takes its place
value.fewerSets: Only {{count}} of {{asked}}: no other set gives tokens within your coins with the prices known today.
